name: New Born — Newborn within the state's enrolment window: bypass PX_280 with PX_GM
description: Ten guided steps, one per row of the 280.1 document: identify the PX_280 hard edit among all eight edits, verify the patient's state, check the event hierarchy, note the date of service and the date of birth, confirm the member search finds no record for the newborn, cross-check the two dates against the 31-day window, select the PX_GM bypass code, validate it and pay the claim.

steps.name: Identify the 280 hard edit
steps.description: Open the Event Resolution tab. The system lists every edit the claim hit; PX_280 (NEWBORN W/I 31/60/61 DAYS) is the Hard Edit highlighted with an error indication, and it is the event you are here to resolve. It fires when the patient is a newborn and the date of service falls inside the enrolment window the member's state grants — the period in which a baby is covered under the parent's policy even though enrolment has not been completed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Event Resolution tab is opened while this step is active. The workspace opens with no tab selected, so the trainee opens it deliberately.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution', the Active Edit section shows Edit Code PX_280 with a Hard Edit badge, and All Edits lists it first.

steps.name: Verify the patient's state
steps.description: Open the Member Info tab and read the State field in the Patient section. The state decides how long the newborn enrolment window runs — 31, 60 or 61 days from birth, which is what the edit's description means by 'W/I 31/60/61 DAYS'. This patient's state is NH, so the window is 31 days.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Member Info tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: On 'Member Info', read State under Patient. It reads NH, so the newborn window is 31 days.

steps.name: Check the event hierarchy
steps.description: Return to the Event Resolution tab and read the rest of the All Edits list. Events are resolved in hierarchy order: anything that precedes PX_280 must be cleared before you touch PX_280. The other seven edits here — PX_SPS, PX_DGX, PX_RFP, PX_NIP, PX_MCO, PX_LUM and PX_UMN — are informational or sit below PX_280 in the hierarchy, so none of them precedes it and you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Event Resolution tab is opened while this step is active. The trainee is on Member Info after step 2, so returning here is a deliberate click.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution', read the seven rows under PX_280 in the All Edits section. None of them precedes PX_280.

steps.name: Note the Date of Service
steps.description: Open the Claim Lines tab and read the Date of Service — the date the services were rendered — from the From date and To columns. Both lines on this claim were rendered on the same day, 09/15/2026. You will measure this date against the patient's date of birth.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: On 'Claim Lines', read From date and To on Line 1 and Line 2: both are 09/15/2026.

steps.name: Note the patient's Date of Birth
steps.description: Return to the Member Info tab and read the patient's Date Of Birth (DOB) in the Patient section. This newborn was born on 09/14/2026. The date of birth is the start of the enrolment window.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Member Info tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: On 'Member Info', read Date Of Birth (DOB) under Patient: 09/14/2026.
steps.checklistItem: Note the patient's Date of Birth

steps.name: Search for the newborn's member record
steps.description: Open the Search tab and select the Member sub-tab to check whether a member record exists for the newborn. The system has already searched with the same HCID that the Member Info tab shows. If a member record is found, the baby is enrolled and the claim follows standard processing guidelines; if nothing is found, the baby has not yet been enrolled under the policy. Here the search returns nothing, so the newborn is not yet enrolled and you go on to validate her eligibility under the newborn provision.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Member sub-tab is selected while this step is active. The Search tab opens on Benefits, so Member is a deliberate selection.
steps.hint: On 'Search', select the 'Member' sub-tab. The system's own search is already filled in and the result reads that member and contract details are not found.
steps.checklistItem: Search for the newborn's member record

steps.name: Validate the 31-day newborn eligibility window
steps.description: Return to the Claim Lines tab and cross-check the patient's date of birth against the date of service. If the date of service falls within 31 days of the date of birth, the newborn is still eligible for coverage under the newborn provision even though enrolment has not been completed; if it falls outside 31 days, the standard enrolment requirements apply instead and the newborn provision does not help. Here the date of birth is 09/14/2026 and the date of service is 09/15/2026 — one day after birth, well inside the 31-day window — so the claim is eligible for processing under the newborn coverage provision.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active. The trainee is on the Search tab after step 6, so returning here is a deliberate click.
steps.hint: Count from the DOB on 'Member Info' (09/14/2026) to the From date on 'Claim Lines' (09/15/2026): one day, inside the 31 days NH allows.

steps.name: Select the PX_GM bypass code
steps.description: Return to the Event Resolution tab and bypass PX_280. In the Bypass Codes section, open the Bypass code list and select PX_GM. The other codes in the list belong to the other events on this claim and do not resolve PX_280.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only when eventResolution.bypassCode is PX_GM. Selecting any other option leaves the step open.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution', open the 'Bypass code' select in the Bypass Codes section and choose PX_GM.

steps.name: Validate the bypass code
steps.description: Click the Validate button on the claim summary to apply the bypass code. The Status and the System message confirm that PX_280 has been bypassed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Validate is pressed with PX_GM selected. If the bypass code has been changed to anything else, the press is refused and the Status asks for the bypass code to be reviewed.
steps.hint: Validate sits on the claim summary bar, next to Submit. Click it once PX_GM is selected.

steps.name: Submit Pay decision
steps.description: The newborn's date of service falls inside the state's enrolment window, so the claim is payable under the newborn provision even though no member record exists yet. Go to the Decision section on the claim summary, choose Pay from the dropdown and click Submit.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Pay decision is submitted.
steps.hint: Choose 'Pay' from the Decision dropdown on the claim summary bar, then click Submit.
